$comment: GlyphPact brand tokens. Single source of truth for identity colour. Change these values to rebrand; site/src/styles/global.css and brand/glyphpact-icon.svg are the only consumers.
name: GlyphPact

ink.role: Near-black canvas. Default page background in the dark scheme, tile background in the standalone icon.

paper.role: Off-white primary text on ink. Frame registration marks in the standalone icon.

accent.role: Drafting-ink cyan. Locked codepoints, anchor nodes, active detail. The identity mark's node.

lossy.role: Approximated or lossy states only. Never decorative.

fail.role: Rejected input and hard failures only. Never decorative.
